_note: Offline NVD snapshot for air-gapped / local mode. Keyed by CPE product-prefix (first 5 CPE fields). A prefix PRESENT with an empty cves[] means 'assessed, none known'; a prefix ABSENT means 'not assessed' (no data) — never rendered as safe. Cloud mode bypasses this and queries NVD live through the egress boundary. Snapshot curated 2024-06.

cves.summary: SIMATIC S7-1200/S7-1500 CPUs protect the integrity/confidentiality of configuration data with a global private key shared across the product line; an attacker who extracts the key from one device can decrypt protected configuration on any device (SSA-568428).
Memory protection bypass on SIMATIC S7-1200/S7-1500 CPUs: an unauthenticated remote attacker on TCP/102 can write/read arbitrary memory and bypass the sandbox to run native code (SSA-434534).
An attacker with network access to the S7-1200 could modify program/firmware on the device before it is loaded, due to insufficient integrity checks on TCP/102 (SSA-232418).
regreSSHion: a signal-handler race condition in OpenSSH server (sshd) allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux.
Remote code execution in ssh-agent's PKCS#11 forwarding: a remote attacker may load and run code via a forwarded agent if specific libraries are present on the victim.
